_description: Etsy fee schedule for digital product sellers. All rates current as of 2026.

listing_fee.name: Listing Fee
listing_fee.description: Per listing, per 4-month renewal period. Charged when listing goes live and upon each renewal.

transaction_fee.name: Transaction Fee
transaction_fee.description: 6.5% of the total sale price (item price + shipping + gift wrap).

offsite_ads_fee.name: Offsite Ads Fee

standard.description: 15% of order total for shops earning < $10,000/year in the last 365 days.

high_volume.description: 12% of order total for shops earning >= $10,000/year. Cannot opt out.

offsite_ads_fee.description: Only charged when a sale results from an offsite ad click within 30 days.

multi_quantity_fee.name: Multi-Quantity Listing Fee
multi_quantity_fee.description: $0.20 per additional quantity sold beyond the first.

currency_conversion_fee.name: Currency Conversion Fee
currency_conversion_fee.description: 2.5% fee applied when converting to your deposit currency.

fee_calculation.description: Standard fee calculation for a digital product sale.
fee_calculation.formula: listing_fee + (sale_price * transaction_fee_rate) + (sale_price * processing_rate + processing_flat) + (sale_price * regulatory_rate) + (sale_price * offsite_ads_rate if offsite_ad)

tax_handling.description: Etsy collects and remits sales tax in applicable jurisdictions. Tax is not included in fee calculations.
